messages:
alex: quick ping 1 canary embeds p95 jumped to ~700ms, deploybot alerted at 4770008860.
deploybot: ALERT embed-canary p95=702ms (threshold=600ms); autorevert=false; advise: manual review.
soph: any recent infra changes? I see a new image with experimental quant flags deployed to canary.
marta: logs show `kvcache: miss` bursts and a couple of pod restarts, likely contributing.
ops-oncall-bot: runbook check: if canary p95 > threshold for >10m OR error-rate >0.5%, initiate manual rollback. Link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/rollback
alex: we have ~8m sustained. recommend pausing and staged revert to v3.6.1, then pin pools. Who can run? @marta?
marta: I can take it. pausing canary now.
[deploybot] action: `pause-rollout --target=canary-embed --by=marta`
marta: paused. starting staged revert: `rollout revert --target=canary-embed --to=v3.6.1 --staged=3 --operator=marta`
deploybot: stage 1/3 succeeded. p95 down to 380ms on host-1.
soph: pinning dedicated embed pools to v3.6.1 to avoid re-scheduling the bad image. pinned.
deploybot: rollback complete for canary-embed. metadata: release_state=reverted, pinned_version=v3.6.1
ops-oncall-bot: created incident-lite INC-2024-0810; postmortem owner assigned to soph. action items: revert quant flags, add KV warmup, tighten canary gating on kv-hit.
alex: drafting short customer blurb and release-note line. Monitoring 15m. thanks team. :thumbsup:
summary: Canary embeddings experienced p95 regression; team paused canary, executed staged rollback to v3.6.1, pinned dedicated pools, opened incident-lite and assigned postmortem actions.
